cases.description: Cold launch from the packaged CLI resolves exact enabled and pinned packages before process creation.
Cold launch from Home reaches the selected target and reports the correlated session outcome.
Cold launch from Setup honors the selected target and permitted world and transition overrides.
Progress and outcomes match their request; process start alone or missing acknowledgement stays unconfirmed.
Disabled target, gamemode and world providers fail preflight and cannot launch via stale observations.
Unresolved legacy selections stay unavailable with repair choices and no silent remapping.
Explicit main-menu overrides remembered autoload; direct startup alone may use remembered selection.
Manager overlay selects targets through the authoritative resolver and session lifecycle.
Switching profiles isolates durable selections, packages, requests and observations.
Safe mode loads no mods, reaches main-menu and preserves malformed durable state without rewriting it.
Observations from another profile, revision or provenance cannot add targets or revive disabled packages.
Free Play launches and runs with Sandbox absent or disabled.
Sandbox creator registration, F5 and pause actions work and release with the session.
Zombies starts, owns pause actions within its session and releases them on stop.
Competing scene and launch requests are Busy during preparing, loading, starting, stopping and native draining.
Late native completion is quarantined or safely retired before a later request owns the executor.
World and scene requests preserve multiplayer authority and reject unauthorized transitions.
Native scene changes apply sceneChangePolicy without implicitly recreating controllers.
A generated gamemode loads through production assembly binding and orchestration without test-only registration.
A generated world loads through production provider binding, readiness and owned cleanup.
Cancellation during LoadingWorld retains native ownership until safe retirement and cleans late arrivals.
Cancellation during Preparing releases allocations and emits one terminal outcome.
Cancellation during StartingMode releases factory and session resources without publishing Running.
Cancellation during Stopping attempts every cleanup and preserves native ownership until drained.
A constructor failure after scoped allocation releases every acquired resource.
Main-menu return stops gameplay and disposes resources without stale controllers or pause actions.
Owner unload cancels the session and removes its bindings and scoped resources atomically.
Restart ends the old session exactly once and creates the new session through the same resolver and executor.
An old session callback cannot stop or restart a newer session.
A startup failure after allocation releases the world, controller and scoped services.
Throwing disposers do not skip later cleanup; failures aggregate into one terminal outcome.
An authored-marker world waits for scene, content, player and spawn readiness before gameplay.
The built-in discovery source enumerates and loads a declared-family concrete instance.
The local discovery source enumerates and loads a declared-family concrete instance.
Missing or ambiguous authored spawn markers fail startup with cleanup and an actionable result.
Open Sandbox generates its real environment, geometry, spawn and kill-plane behavior.
